description: Draw a rigged .glb as an image to look at: at rest, or posed at a moment of one of its animations, with its skeleton over it (blue: its left, red: its right, orange: the middle) and rulers in model units. Pinkish-red skin is the inside of the mesh showing (a tear, or a part pushed through another). Also returns every joint drawn in the image with its pixel position and, posed, how far its lowest point is from the rest floor (lowest_point_vs_floor, % of height). Runs on this computer, free.

animation.description: pose it in this animation (inspect_rig lists them); default: at rest

file.description: a rigged .glb (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory): one rig_model wrote, or any model on afk.ai's skeletons

focus.description: zoom on a joint (name) or a point [x, y, z]

joints.description: joints to draw (default main: no fingers or tips)

radius.description: the zoomed area's radius in model units (default 15% of the height)

time.description: seconds into the animation (default: its middle; inspect_rig gives each problem's worst moment)

type.description: the body type, when it can't be told from the file (afk.ai's files say)

views.description: default front and left (front looks from +Z, so the model's left is on the image's right)

weights.description: true: color the skin by the bone each part follows; a bone name: how much each part follows that bone (blue none, red all)

xray.description: the mesh see-through, to see joints inside it

name: render_rig
